HEADER: Init +11; Senses Cloud sight, Dragon senses; Perception +16
DEFENSE: AC 25, touch 17, flat-footed 17 (+7 dex, +8 natural, +1 dodge, -1 size)
DR 5/magic; Immune Wind, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Earth 50%
OFFENSE: Melee Bite +15 (2d6+6), 2 Claws +15 (1d8+4), 2 Wings +10 (1d6+2), Tail Slap +10 (1d8+6)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks Breath Weapon (40-ft. cone, 6d10 wind damage, Reflex DC 19 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Sandstorm
At will - detect magic, mending, message, read magic
1st (DC 17) - alter winds, choco feather, wind armor, wind runner, wind shield
2nd (DC 18) - elemental resistance, float, whisper wind, wind barrier
3rd (DC 19) - battering blast, cloak of winds, dispel, hurricane blast, wind wall
4th (DC 20) - air walk, freedom of movement, river of wind
STATISTICS: Str 18, Dex 25, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 22, Cha 12
Base Atk +12; CMB +17; CMD 35 (39 vs. trip)
Feats Cleave, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack
Skills Fly +24, Knowledge (nature) +14, Perception +16, Spellcraft +14, Stealth +18, Survival +16; Racial Modifiers +8 Fly
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Breath Wing (su) Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, a green dragon can use its wings to cause a breath-like attack to slice the air in front of it in a 30-ft.- cone. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of wind damage, Reflex save (DC 22) for half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
Cloud Sight (su) A green dragon's sight is not impeded by clouds or fog, or by spells that create areas of fog.

Sandstorm (su) Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a green dragon can cause a sandstorm at its enemies within a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect must make a Fortitude save (DC 22) for half damage and negating the effect or takes 6d6 points of wind damage, 6d6 points of earth damage, and be inflicted with Blind status for 1d6 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

White Wind (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds a green dragon can emit a gust of white wind that heals allies other than itself within 20 feet for an amount equal to the green dragon's current hit points in damage. The healing received per creature is capped at 10 per hit die attained for the caster (ex: 7 hit dice would mean a cap of 70 healing for each creature). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4rd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 23).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
